cue.heading: Rule 12(b) — How to present defenses
cue.text: Every defense to a claim for relief in any pleading must be asserted in the responsive pleading if one is required. <mark>But a party may assert the following defenses by motion</mark>: … (6) failure to state a claim upon which relief can be granted; …
